t_advice_summary_textbox.text: In general the gnomes with short hats give the most points, in particular ones in yellow. Additionally the gnomes with large brown hats give lots of points too.

vb_textbox.text: The gnomes with the brightest colour hats tend to score the highest points e.g. yellow, green, blues. Whenever there is a streak of yellow baskets in the forest, the gnomes with taller hats seem to score the best.
